costMethodology: Only a reconciled program attendance estimate receives a numeric headline. Partial tuition, annual and initial-term figures are shown as components, never as a full-program total. Phase sums use published rates and allowances, not future guaranteed prices. Missing costs remain unconfirmed rather than being assigned an artificial minimum.
